rules.observed: Permit required before cutting into or replacing pipes, particularly pipes covered by a wall; inspected before covering pipes; license scopes listed.
Minor repairs to existing interior plaster or wallboard are listed as not needing a permit unless required for fire protection. This does not establish an exemption for the plumbing work.
Online kitchen/bath path is for in-kind fixture replacement with no structural work; R-2 apartment owners must hire contractors for electrical or plumbing work.
Current small-job exemption is under $1,000 aggregate, casual/minor/inconsequential, and no building permit required; amended by AB 1170 effective 2026-01-01.
B general building definition and limits; appropriate specialty classification or appropriately licensed subcontractor required where applicable.
C-36 covers proper disposal of fluid waste and maintenance/replacement of described items.
C-9 covers gypsum wallboard assemblies, taping and texturing.
Get at least three written bids on identical scope; do not automatically accept lowest bid; verify license, address, phone, workers' compensation and general liability insurance.
Written contract should detail work, price, payments, permits and completion; down payment no more than 10% or $1,000, whichever is less, subject to stated bond exception.
